policy.implementation_ready_requires: approval_state == locked and all required fields complete

abilities.name: Controlled Fury
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — Ability Game Health redesign audit (owner-approved 2026-09-28)
abilities.exact_effect: The first time the user falls below 50% HP, it gains +1 Attack and +1 Speed. For the next 3 turns, its damaging moves deal 10% more damage, and each direct damaging move it uses causes recoil equal to 10% of its max HP.
abilities.trigger: Once per battle, when the user's HP first falls below 50%.
abilities.restrictions: The 3-turn damage/recoil window begins on activation. Recoil applies only after the user's direct damaging moves; status moves do not cause recoil.
abilities.duplicate_status: Resolved as a distinct Mercury redesign; no unresolved duplicate in the locked intake set.

abilities.name: Eternal Life
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — Ability Game Health redesign audit (owner-approved 2026-09-28)
abilities.exact_effect: The first time the user reaches 50% HP or less, it restores 25% of its max HP, cures any major status condition, and removes all negative stat stages.
abilities.trigger: Once per battle, when the user's HP first reaches 50% or less while it is still conscious.
abilities.restrictions: Cannot activate at 0 HP and does not revive a fainted user. Triggers only once per battle.
abilities.duplicate_status: Resolved replacement for the retired long-delay revival concept; no unresolved duplicate in the locked intake set.

abilities.name: Hollow Shell
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — Ability Game Health redesign audit (owner-approved 2026-09-28)
abilities.exact_effect: If the user is actually knocked out by a direct damaging move, the attacker loses 25% of its max HP. This damage cannot reduce the attacker below 1 HP.
abilities.trigger: When the user faints as the direct result of an opponent's damaging move.
abilities.restrictions: Does not trigger from poison, burn, weather, hazards, recoil, self-KO effects, temporary revival effects, or other indirect KOs. Retaliation is nonlethal and leaves the attacker at a minimum of 1 HP.
abilities.duplicate_status: Resolved Mercury redesign of the prior attacker-faints-on-KO concept; no unresolved duplicate in the locked intake set.

abilities.name: Mind Games
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — Ability Game Health redesign audit (owner-approved 2026-09-28)
abilities.exact_effect: On switch-in, the opponent's actual last-used move is sealed for 2 turns.
abilities.trigger: When the user enters battle and the opposing active Pokémon has a recorded last-used move.
abilities.restrictions: Has no effect if the target has no prior recorded move. Only one move is sealed at a time. The seal lasts 2 turns and is cleared if the affected Pokémon switches out.
abilities.duplicate_status: Resolved Mercury redesign of Mind Game; distinct from ordinary Disable by trigger and targeting rule.

abilities.name: The Look
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — Ability Game Health audit (locked 2026-09-28)
abilities.exact_effect: While the user is active, opposing active Pokémon cannot use the same move they used immediately before.
abilities.trigger: Continuous while the ability holder is active; checked when an opposing active Pokémon selects a move.
abilities.restrictions: The restriction ends when the ability holder leaves the field. Switching the opposing Pokémon naturally resets its own immediately-previous-move context.
abilities.duplicate_status: Mechanically Torment-like but retained as a distinct continuous ability effect; duplicate resolution complete.

abilities.name: Unyielding
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — sealed Ability Audit Final
abilities.exact_effect: Whenever an opponent causes one or more of the user's stat stages to drop, the user gains +1 Defense and +1 Special Defense.
abilities.trigger: After an opponent-caused stat-stage reduction is successfully applied to the user.
abilities.restrictions: Only opponent-caused stat drops qualify. Self-inflicted drops and allied effects do not trigger it.
abilities.duplicate_status: Locked Mercury audit entry; duplicate resolution complete.

abilities.name: Pack Tactics
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — sealed Ability Audit Final
abilities.exact_effect: The user's damaging moves deal 1.2× damage while it has at least one conscious party teammate, or 1.3× damage while it has an active doubles partner.
abilities.trigger: Continuous damage-calculation modifier while the relevant ally condition is met.
abilities.restrictions: The 1.2× and 1.3× multipliers do not stack; an active doubles partner uses the 1.3× value.
abilities.duplicate_status: Locked Mercury audit entry; duplicate resolution complete.

abilities.name: First Strike
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — sealed Ability Audit Final
abilities.exact_effect: The first damaging move the user uses after each entry to battle gains +1 priority.
abilities.trigger: On the user's first damaging move after entering battle.
abilities.restrictions: Status moves do not consume the effect. The effect resets when the user leaves battle and later re-enters.
abilities.duplicate_status: Locked Mercury audit entry; duplicate resolution complete.

abilities.name: Bloodhound
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — sealed Ability Audit Final
abilities.exact_effect: A foe directly damaged by the user becomes marked. If that marked foe switches out, the replacement Pokémon loses 1/8 of its max HP and the mark is consumed.
abilities.trigger: Marks a foe after direct damage from the user; retaliation resolves when that marked foe switches out.
abilities.restrictions: The switch punishment occurs once per mark and is consumed after applying. Indirect damage does not create the mark.
abilities.duplicate_status: Locked Mercury audit entry; duplicate resolution complete.

abilities.name: Grand Choreography
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — sealed Ability Audit Final
abilities.exact_effect: The user retains Dancer behavior. After it successfully uses or copies a Dance move, it immediately follows with one 50-BP Revelation Dance. The follow-up checks the Fire, Electric, Psychic, and Ghost Revelation Dance styles; if any of them would be super-effective against the target, the follow-up's final effectiveness is exactly 2×.
abilities.trigger: After a successful Dance move resolves through the user's Dancer/Grand Choreography behavior.
abilities.restrictions: Only one 50-BP Revelation Dance follow-up is created per qualifying Dance resolution. The effectiveness override is capped at exactly 2× rather than stacking higher. Non-Dance moves do not trigger the follow-up.
abilities.duplicate_status: Locked Mega Oricorio signature Ability; duplicate resolution complete.

abilities.name: Overexertion
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — sealed Ability Audit Final
abilities.exact_effect: The user can act every turn. After it uses a damaging move, it loses 10% of its max HP.
abilities.trigger: Continuous removal of the normal loafing restriction; recoil resolves after each damaging move used.
abilities.restrictions: Status moves do not cause HP loss. The ability is non-suppressible, non-copyable, and cannot be overwritten.
abilities.duplicate_status: Locked Mega Slaking signature Ability; duplicate resolution complete.

abilities.name: Ancient Script
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — sealed Ability Audit Final
abilities.exact_effect: Hidden Power receives its ordinary STAB modifier and then an additional 1.3× damage multiplier.
abilities.trigger: During damage calculation when the user uses Hidden Power.
abilities.restrictions: Applies only to Hidden Power. The 1.3× multiplier is additional to normal STAB rather than replacing it.
abilities.duplicate_status: Locked replacement for the retired Unown Revelation transformation; duplicate resolution complete.

abilities.name: Aura Mantle
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — locked Mega Lucario Z Pokédex amendment
abilities.exact_effect: Damage the user takes from contact moves is reduced by 40%. When the user deals damage with an Aura or Pulse move, it restores HP equal to 25% of the actual damage dealt.
abilities.trigger: Contact-damage reduction is checked during incoming damage calculation; healing resolves after a qualifying Aura/Pulse move deals damage.
abilities.restrictions: The healing amount is based on actual damage dealt. Non-contact incoming moves are not reduced, and non-Aura/non-Pulse attacks do not heal.
abilities.duplicate_status: Locked signature Ability; duplicate resolution complete.

abilities.name: Sand Skimmer
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — locked Mega Garchomp Z design
abilities.exact_effect: The user is immune to sandstorm damage. While sandstorm is active, its Speed is multiplied by 1.30 and damaging Ground-type moves cannot hit it.
abilities.trigger: Continuous while the user is active; the Speed and Ground-move protection portions are active only during sandstorm.
abilities.restrictions: Does not grant permanent Ground immunity outside sandstorm. Sandstorm damage immunity remains active regardless.
abilities.duplicate_status: Locked signature Ability; duplicate resolution complete.

abilities.name: Calamity Edge
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — locked Mega Absol Z design
abilities.exact_effect: Slicing moves used by the user deal 30% more damage and ignore the target's positive Defense stat stages.
abilities.trigger: During damage calculation for the user's slicing moves.
abilities.restrictions: Only slicing moves qualify. Negative or neutral Defense stages are not ignored.
abilities.duplicate_status: Locked signature Ability; duplicate resolution complete.

abilities.name: Permafrost
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — locked Mega Baxcalibur design
abilities.exact_effect: Super-effective damage taken by the user is multiplied by 0.65.
abilities.trigger: During incoming damage calculation when the attack is super-effective.
abilities.restrictions: Applies only to super-effective damage.
abilities.duplicate_status: Filter/Solid Rock family variant intentionally retained as a distinct signature Ability; duplicate resolution complete.

abilities.name: Dam Builder
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — locked Youngster Martin / Mega Bibarel design
abilities.exact_effect: When the user enters battle, it gains +1 Defense and +1 Special Defense.
abilities.trigger: On each entry to battle, once for that entry.
abilities.restrictions: The boost is applied once per entry; ordinary stat-stage caps still apply.
abilities.duplicate_status: Locked signature Ability; duplicate resolution complete.

abilities.name: Nerve Agent
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — locked Mega Drapion design
abilities.exact_effect: When the user hits a target with a damaging Poison-type contact move, make one 30% effect roll for that target and move. On success, choose Poison or Paralysis with equal probability; if the chosen status is invalid, use the other status when legal.
abilities.trigger: After a damaging Poison-type contact move successfully hits a target.
abilities.restrictions: Rolls once per target per move, not once per hit on multi-hit moves. Does not replace an existing major status condition and obeys normal status immunities.
abilities.duplicate_status: Locked signature Ability; duplicate resolution complete.

abilities.name: Siege Engine
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — locked Mega Rhyperior design
abilities.exact_effect: Siege-class attacks used by the user deal 30% more damage. The user does not take recoil or crash damage caused by its own moves.
abilities.trigger: Damage boost is checked during damage calculation for moves carrying the Siege-class flag; recoil/crash prevention is checked when self-inflicted move recoil or crash damage would resolve.
abilities.restrictions: Does not prevent Explosion/Self-Destruct self-KO, Life Orb recoil, Struggle recoil, or other non-move-recoil HP costs. Siege qualification uses a dedicated move flag.
abilities.duplicate_status: Locked signature Ability; duplicate resolution complete.

abilities.name: Ultra Instinct
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — sealed Batch 3Q-S9 ability-import parent (2026-09-01)
abilities.exact_effect: Damage taken by the user is multiplied by 0.8. After the user is hit by a qualifying contact move, it retaliates with a 20-BP Vacuum Wave.
abilities.trigger: The damage reduction is continuous; the retaliation is queued after a qualifying contact hit successfully damages the user.
abilities.restrictions: Only qualifying contact hits trigger the retaliation. The retaliation uses Vacuum Wave at 20 base power.
abilities.duplicate_status: Sealed imported custom Ability; duplicate resolution complete in the authoritative S9 parent.

abilities.name: No Turning Back
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — sealed Batch 3Q-S9 ability-import parent (2026-09-01)
abilities.exact_effect: Once per switch-in, when the user's HP crosses from at least half to below half, it gains +1 Attack, +1 Defense, +1 Special Attack, +1 Special Defense, and +1 Speed, and enters the No Retreat state.
abilities.trigger: On the first below-half-HP threshold crossing after each switch-in.
abilities.restrictions: Can trigger only once per switch-in. The No Retreat state prevents retreat according to the existing No Retreat mechanic.
abilities.duplicate_status: Sealed imported custom Ability; duplicate resolution complete in the authoritative S9 parent.

abilities.name: Deadly Precision
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — sealed Batch 3Q-S9 ability-import parent (2026-09-01)
abilities.exact_effect: If one of the user's moves is super-effective when breakable target abilities are ignored for the effectiveness check, that move cannot miss and bypasses the target's breakable Ability while resolving.
abilities.trigger: During move effectiveness, accuracy, and target-Ability checks for the user's attacks.
abilities.restrictions: The benefit applies only to moves that qualify as super-effective under the ability-suppressed effectiveness probe.
abilities.duplicate_status: Sealed imported custom Ability; duplicate resolution complete in the authoritative S9 parent.

abilities.name: Fire's Wrath
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — sealed Batch 3Q-S9 ability-import parent (2026-09-01)
abilities.exact_effect: The user retains the Fearmonger entry effect. In addition, each successful non-contact damaging hit by the user has a 10% chance to burn its target.
abilities.trigger: Fearmonger resolves on entry; the burn check resolves after a successful non-contact damaging hit.
abilities.restrictions: The 10% burn chance applies only to successful non-contact damaging hits and obeys normal burn immunities and status rules.
abilities.duplicate_status: Sealed imported custom Ability; duplicate resolution complete in the authoritative S9 parent.

abilities.name: Pinnacle Blade
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — sealed Batch 3Q-S9 ability-import parent (2026-09-01)
abilities.exact_effect: Keen Edge moves used by the user bypass accuracy checks, protection, substitutes, and screens. After a successful Keen Edge hit, applicable protection and barrier state is destroyed.
abilities.trigger: During targeting/resolution of the user's Keen Edge moves, with the shatter effect after a successful hit.
abilities.restrictions: Only moves classified as Keen Edge receive these effects.
abilities.duplicate_status: Sealed imported custom Ability; duplicate resolution complete in the authoritative S9 parent.

abilities.name: Overrule
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — sealed Batch 3Q-S9 ability-import parent (2026-09-01)
abilities.exact_effect: When the user's attack lands a critical hit, that hit bypasses the target's breakable Ability. If the critical hit would otherwise be resisted, the resisted critical damage is doubled through the resistance modifier.
abilities.trigger: During critical-hit damage resolution.
abilities.restrictions: The target-Ability bypass and resisted-damage correction apply only when the attack is actually a critical hit.
abilities.duplicate_status: Sealed imported custom Ability; duplicate resolution complete in the authoritative S9 parent.

abilities.name: Frostbind
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — sealed Batch 3Q-S9 ability-import parent (2026-09-01)
abilities.exact_effect: Whenever the user actually inflicts Frostbite on a target, that target's last usable move is also Disabled if ordinary Disable restrictions allow it.
abilities.trigger: Immediately after the user successfully inflicts Frostbite.
abilities.restrictions: Does not trigger unless Frostbite was actually inflicted. Disable must still pass its normal validity restrictions.
abilities.duplicate_status: Sealed imported custom Ability; duplicate resolution complete in the authoritative S9 parent.

abilities.name: Harukaze
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — sealed Batch 3Q-S9 ability-import parent (2026-09-01)
abilities.exact_effect: When the user successfully sets Grassy Terrain, Tailwind is also started for its side. When the user successfully starts Tailwind, Grassy Terrain is also set.
abilities.trigger: After the holder successfully creates either Grassy Terrain or Tailwind.
abilities.restrictions: Only field effects set by the holder trigger the paired effect.
abilities.duplicate_status: Sealed imported custom Ability; duplicate resolution complete in the authoritative S9 parent.

abilities.name: Chestnut Axe
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — sealed Batch 3Q-S9 ability-import parent (2026-09-01)
abilities.exact_effect: All Grass-type moves used by the user are treated as Keen Edge moves and inherit the normal Keen Edge interactions and boost handling.
abilities.trigger: Whenever the user's move classification is checked.
abilities.restrictions: Only the user's Grass-type moves gain Keen Edge classification through this Ability.
abilities.duplicate_status: Sealed imported custom Ability; duplicate resolution complete in the authoritative S9 parent.

abilities.name: Coward
abilities.source: Pokémon Mercury Redux — sealed Batch 3Q-S9 ability-import parent (2026-09-01)
abilities.exact_effect: The first time this party Pokémon enters battle during a battle, it automatically gains the Protect effect for that entry.
abilities.trigger: On entry, if this party Pokémon has not previously triggered Coward during the current battle.
abilities.restrictions: Can trigger only once per party Pokémon per battle; later entries do not activate it again.
abilities.duplicate_status: Sealed imported custom Ability; duplicate resolution complete in the authoritative S9 parent.
